newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Cholera kills five in Venezuela, now under control.
newsitem.headline: Cholera kills five in Venezuela, now under control.

text.p: A bout of cholera in Venezuela has killed five people and hospitalized 152 others but is now under control, a Health Ministry official said on Monday.
The cholera outbreak, which began last week, appeared to have originated near the border with Colombia, Oswaldo Godoy, director of the ministry's Epidemic Watch unit told Reuters.
Godoy said no new cases had been reported in recent hours and there was no sign of the epidemic spreading.
